title: Serve actionable access plans and retrieval recipes
objective: The access/recipe tools can describe tested public and verified manual routes.
outcome: Public CMS, keyed Census and restricted HCUP fixtures produce different legitimate next steps. A returned recipe contains no secret or source payload and does not execute merely because a client inspected it. Missing cost/quota information stays unknown. Generated examples reproduce the validated recipe without embedding a credential. Nonretryable route_not_documented no longer tells clients to retry blindly. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. packages/identity/access-workflows remains unused because identity is WP7-sealed; owned implementation lives in packages/registry/qualified-access-routes.mjs. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Map qualified route contexts
commits.instructions: Use accepted release/distribution/access-route IDs and documented requirements. Keep source-side authorization separate from USHSO metadata operation.
commits.verification: Public CMS, keyed Census and restricted HCUP fixtures produce different legitimate next steps.

commits.subject: Return tested recipes and precise limits
commits.instructions: Include method, endpoint template, parameter meanings, required credentials by name only, pagination, expected schema and latest test receipt. Keep unknowns. Generate cURL/Python from tested recipes without embedding a credential.
commits.verification: A returned recipe contains no secret or source payload; it does not execute merely because a client inspected it.

commits.subject: Replace generic retry guidance
commits.instructions: For missing context, point to the exact discover/get_asset action or source documentation. Retry only when the recorded error is transient.
commits.verification: Nonretryable route_not_documented no longer tells clients to retry blindly against unchanged metadata.
